head.label: For brands
head.title: Small channels, chosen for your brand
head.lead: Tell us what you want to promote, and a person chooses small YouTube channels that suit it.

points.label: What we offer
points.title: Chosen by a person, approved by you

items.title: Channels chosen by hand
items.text: A person looks at each channel before we suggest it. No automatic list, no algorithm.

items.title: Only small channels
items.text: Every channel we work with is on YouTube and has 1,000 to 50,000 subscribers.

items.title: You approve each channel
items.text: You see every channel we suggest, and none goes ahead without your approval.

steps.label: Three steps
steps.title: How it works for a brand

items.title: You send an inquiry
items.text: Tell us your company, what you want to promote and your budget range.

items.title: We suggest channels
items.text: We come back with small YouTube channels that suit what you want to promote.

items.title: You approve
items.text: You approve the channels you want, and a deal goes ahead once the creator says yes too.

price.label: Cost
price.title: You pay the agreed fee and nothing more
price.text: Our commission is taken from the creator’s fee, and only once a deal is done.

form.label: Inquiry
form.title: Start with a short inquiry
form.lead: A few details are enough, and we will write back to the email address you give.

promote.label: What you want to promote
promote.hint: The product or service, in a sentence or two.
promote.error: Tell us what you want to promote.

email.label: Email
email.error: Enter an email address, like name@example.com.

phone.label: Phone
phone.hint: Include the country code, such as +1.
phone.error: Check the number, or leave this field empty.

form.privacy: We use these details to reply to your inquiry and to suggest channels.
